evals.name: upgrade-v8-compensatory
evals.prompt:
Set up or upgrade this repository using the latest AI Engineering Bootstrap:

https://github.com/jkrogsgaard/AI-Engineering
evals.expected_output: A v8 repository with compensatory instructions is audited to the current baseline: the provenance marker records the fetched VERSION, the exact upstream commit, and today's date; hard boundaries, domain invariants, and verified commands survive; compensatory emphasis (CRITICAL/double-check/if-in-doubt) is removed or justified; the generic playbook seed list is removed or gutted.
files: synthetic repo: small Python CLI with .ai-engineering.yml at version 8, AGENTS.md mixing durable truth with compensatory patterns, AI_ENGINEERING_PLAYBOOK.md with the old generic seed list
assertions: Marker records the current upstream version
Marker source_commit is the real upstream HEAD SHA (full 40 hex, never a branch name)
Marker last_reviewed is the audit date
Generic playbook seed removed or gutted

evals.name: fresh-bootstrap-minimal
evals.prompt:
Set up or upgrade this repository using the latest AI Engineering Bootstrap:

https://github.com/jkrogsgaard/AI-Engineering
evals.expected_output: A tiny repository with no AI setup gets a first bootstrap: a provenance marker with the fetched VERSION, exact upstream commit, and today's date; at most a lean root instruction file; no manufactured infrastructure (no playbook, docs hierarchy, skills, agents, or AI-context files).
files: synthetic repo: single small Python script plus README, no AI files, no marker
assertions: Marker created with the current upstream version
Marker source_commit is the real upstream HEAD SHA (full 40 hex, never a branch name)
Marker last_reviewed is the audit date
No manufactured infrastructure (no playbook, AI-context file, docs/, .claude/skills/, .claude/agents/)
Root instruction file lean (<=100 lines) or absent
